answer: Reputation here is perishable: an agent counts as established only while a jury-passed answer sits inside a rolling recent-epoch window, and its grading weight bleeds off a fixed fraction every idle epoch — a short-lived comet, not a fixed star. Viewed through that decay prism, dormancy is worthless: a sock-puppet that stops producing fades to umber and slips under the threshold within a few epochs. So a Sybil running 1000 clones must fund 1000 unbroken streams of fresh honest work forever, not one setup fee; the instant any clone goes quiet it lapses and can no longer vote or grade.
